[
  {
    "cell_type": "markdown",
    "metadata": {},
    "source": [
      "# NYC Taxi Demand Analysis\n",
      "\n",
      "**Business Question:** How does taxi demand vary over time and space in NYC, and what are the fare characteristics?\n",
      "\n",
      "**Data Source:** `samples.nyctaxi.trips` table in the Databricks sample data."
    ]
  },
  {
    "cell_type": "code",
    "metadata": {},
    "source": [
      "# Load the trips table\n",
      "df = spark.table(\"samples.nyctaxi.trips\")\n",
      "df.createOrReplaceTempView(\"trips\")"
    ]
  },
  {
    "cell_type": "markdown",
    "metadata": {},
    "source": [
      "## Trips by hour of day"
    ]
  },
  {
    "cell_type": "code",
    "metadata": {},
    "source": [
      "from pyspark.sql.functions import hour, col\n",
      "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
      "import pandas as pd\n",
      "\n",
      "hour_counts = spark.sql(\"SELECT hour(pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour\")\n",
      "pdf = hour_counts.toPandas()\n",
      "plt.figure(figsize=(8,4))\n",
      "plt.bar(pdf['hour'], pdf['trips'], color='skyblue')\n",
      "plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')\n",
      "plt.ylabel('Number of Trips')\n",
      "plt.title('Trips by Hour of Day')\n",
      "plt.tight_layout()\n",
      "plt.show()\n",
      "display(hour_counts)"
    ]
  },
  {
    "cell_type": "markdown",
    "metadata": {},
    "source": [
      "## Fare behaviour by trip‑distance bucket"
    ]
  },
  {
    "cell_type": "code",
    "metadata": {},
    "source": [
      "from pyspark.sql.functions import when, round\n",
      "# Define distance buckets\n",
      "bucketed = df.withColumn(\"dist_bucket\", \n        when(col(\"trip_distance\") < 1, \"<1 mile\")\n        .when(col(\"trip_distance\") < 3, \"1‑3 miles\")\n        .when(col(\"trip_distance\") < 5, \"3‑5 miles\")\n        .otherwise(\">=5 miles\")\n      )\n",
      "bucket_stats = bucketed.groupBy(\"dist_bucket\").agg(\n        round(avg(\"fare_amount\"),2).alias(\"avg_fare\"),\n        count(\"fare_amount\").alias(\"trip_cnt\")\n      ).orderBy(\"dist_bucket\")\n",
      "display(bucket_stats)\n",
      "pdf2 = bucket_stats.toPandas()\n",
      "plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))\n",
      "plt.bar(pdf2['dist_bucket'], pdf2['avg_fare'], color='lightgreen')\n",
      "plt.xlabel('Distance bucket')\n",
      "plt.ylabel('Average fare ($)')\n",
      "plt.title('Average Fare by Distance Bucket')\n",
      "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
      "plt.tight_layout()\n",
      "plt.show()"
    ]
  },
  {
    "cell_type": "markdown",
    "metadata": {},
    "source": [
      "## Top 10 pickup ZIP codes by trip count"
    ]
  },
  {
    "cell_type": "code",
    "metadata": {},
    "source": [
      "top_zips = spark.sql(\"SELECT pickup_zip, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM trips WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pickup_zip ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 10\")\n",
      "display(top_zips)\n",
      "pdf3 = top_zips.toPandas()\n",
      "plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))\n",
      "plt.bar(pdf3['pickup_zip'].astype(str), pdf3['trips'], color='orange')\n",
      "plt.xlabel('Pickup ZIP')\n",
      "plt.ylabel('Trips')\n",
      "plt.title('Top 10 Pickup ZIP Codes')\n",
      "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
      "plt.tight_layout()\n",
      "plt.show()"
    ]
  },
  {
    "cell_type": "markdown",
    "metadata": {},
    "source": [
      "## Findings"
    ]
  },
  {
    "cell_type": "code",
    "metadata": {},
    "source": [
      "import json\n",
      "# Total number of trips\n",
      "n_trips = spark.table(\"samples.nyctaxi.trips\").count()\n",
      "# Peak hour (most pickups)\n",
      "peak_hour_row = spark.sql(\"SELECT hour(pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trips GROUP BY hour ORDER BY cnt DESC, hour ASC\").first()\n",
      "peak_hour = peak_hour_row['hour'] if peak_hour_row else None\n",
      "# Avg fare per mile (only trips with distance > 0)\n",
      "agg = df.filter(col('trip_distance') > 0).agg((spark_sum('fare_amount')/spark_sum('trip_distance')).alias('avg_fpm')).first()\n",
      "avg_fare_per_mile = round(agg['avg_fpm'], 2) if agg['avg_fpm'] is not None else None\n",
      "# Display findings\n",
      "display(spark.createDataFrame([\"Total trips: {}\", \"Peak hour: {}\", \"Avg fare per mile: ${}\"].format(n_trips, peak_hour, avg_fare_per_mile)))\n",
      "# Exit with JSON\n",
      "result = {\n    \"n_trips\": n_trips,\n    \"peak_hour\": peak_hour,\n    \"avg_fare_per_mile\": avg_fare_per_mile\n}\n",
      "dbutils.notebook.exit(json.dumps(result))"
    ]
  }
]
